# SignalFlow Studio

> SignalFlow Studio is an open-source, review-first campaign workspace that turns product notes, public links, GitHub repository context, and supported text/code files into editable drafts for twelve publishing destinations.

## Current product

Users add evidence, select destinations, choose a real model provider route, generate, review one authoritative current draft per channel, and then save locally, export, copy/open a destination, or use a genuinely configured official connector.

## Implemented capabilities

- Drafts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Reddit, Hacker News, YouTube, TikTok, newsletters, blogs, and release notes.
- Context extraction from public links, public GitHub repositories, and supported browser-readable files.
- Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, OpenRouter, Groq, custom OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, and LM Studio adapters subject to deployment/session capability.
- Versioned browser-local campaign saving and legacy migration.
- Deterministic Markdown/JSON export from one authoritative current draft per channel.
- Official connector code paths for LinkedIn, X, and Reddit with explicit review and destination-API-confirmed success.
- Manual copy/export/open workflows for other destinations.
- A versioned hosted/local/self-hosted capability endpoint at `/api/capabilities`.
- MCP capability/provider/generation tools through the supported `mcp/` package.

## Important boundaries

- Campaign generation requires a real model route; retired template, offline, prompt-only, and substitute fallback output are rejected.
- Server-configured providers and connector administration may require an authenticated owner session.
- Saved campaigns are currently browser-local; cloud database, cross-device sync, collaboration, durable jobs, and billing quotas are not implemented.
- Image/video uploads are metadata references in the active route, not automatic visual understanding.
- The browser extension can perform a capability handshake, but acknowledged ingestion, screenshots, recordings, and upload queues are not implemented.
- Direct publishing is not available for every destination and is reported successful only after the destination API confirms it.
- Generated drafts require factual, brand, accessibility, legal, and compliance review before use.
